codeReview.summary: The feature implements copytruncate rotation, config keys, and append-mode logging, but max-files enforcement is not robust when existing archive numbering has gaps.

issues.description: Archive cleanup stops at the first missing number (`while True` + `break`), so archives beyond `max_files` can remain when numbering is sparse (e.g., `.1.gz` and `.3.gz` with `max_files=2`). Repro: running rotate_log in that state leaves `service.log.3.gz` present, violating max-files enforcement.

Tests verify max-files behavior only with contiguous archive sequences generated by repeated rotations; there is no regression test for sparse pre-existing archives, which allowed the cleanup bug above to go undetected.
